parameters.query:
=SELECT c.conversation_url, c.last_replied_at
FROM conversations c
WHERE c.conversation_url = '{{ $json.conversationUrl }}'
  AND c.last_replied_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '4 hours';

=INSERT INTO conversations (prospect_id, platform, conversation_url, last_message, last_replied_at, score, intent, status)
VALUES (
  (SELECT id FROM prospects WHERE linkedin_url = '{{ $('prepare-reply').item.json.conversationUrl }}' OR instagram_username = '{{ $('prepare-reply').item.json.senderName }}' LIMIT 1),
  '{{ $('prepare-reply').item.json.platform }}',
  '{{ $('prepare-reply').item.json.conversationUrl }}',
  '{{ $('prepare-reply').item.json.lastMessage.replace("'", "''") }}',
  NOW(),
  {{ $('prepare-reply').item.json.analysis.score }},
  '{{ $('prepare-reply').item.json.analysis.intent }}',
  'replied'
)
ON CONFLICT (conversation_url) DO UPDATE
  SET last_message = EXCLUDED.last_message,
      last_replied_at = EXCLUDED.last_replied_at,
      score = EXCLUDED.score,
      intent = EXCLUDED.intent,
      updated_at = NOW();
